title: Map dependency chains for the 'Unblocks title' PR series
objective: 108 open PRs carry 'unblocks title' and 373 PR bodies contain 'Depends on #N'.
description: 108 open PRs carry 'unblocks title' and 373 PR bodies contain 'Depends on #N'. Several titles have 4-7 PRs (PPSA01317, PPSA26344, PPSA99169, CUSA00900, PPSA02015, CUSA00223). Build a dependency graph from the Depends on/Unblocks lines and produce an ordered merge plan per title.
acceptance: Graph (JSON) of PR -> depends-on PRs for all open PRs, with closed/merged dependencies marked
Ordered plan for each title with >= 4 PRs
Cycles or dependencies on closed-unmerged PRs are flagged
